resolved_findings.criterion: COR-01/COR-04: terminal authority survives generic cancellation and scope revocation
resolved_findings.evidence: packages/core/src/agents-execution.ts:74-99 accepts a stopped success and publishes its output during read-only reconciliation unless agent_tasks.cancelRequested is set. packages/core/src/agents.ts:186-187 propagates Foundation uncertainty without retaining its reason. packages/core/src/foundation-effects.ts:279-280 and :320-322 revoke running authority through generic cancellation/epoch advancement without setting that task flag. apps/control-api/src/foundation-routes.ts:85 exposes generic cancellation. The permitted held/old-epoch reconciliation therefore overwrites CANCELLED_WITH_UNCERTAIN_EFFECT or ACTIVATION_FENCED with succeeded on a late terminal observation, violating AC-727.
resolved_findings.refutation: AgentEngine.cancel sets the flag and correctly masks late success, but the shared Foundation cancellation route and epoch advancement bypass that method. Held reconciliation must remain available to prove physical termination; that does not require treating revoked work as a successful authorized task or publishing its late result. Heavy slots and conservative charging are correctly retained until physical proof, so premature capacity release is not this finding.
resolved_findings.suggestion: Durably retain terminal authority revocation for Hermes tasks on all shared Foundation invalidation paths; allow read-only physical reconciliation while preserving cancelled/fenced logical outcome and suppressing late output. Cover generic cancel and epoch-fence followed by stopped success.
resolved_findings.resolution: Source independently verified including cancellation of already-unknown Hermes runs: shared uncertainty durably retains generic cancellation/epoch revocation; final read-only observation checks original epoch and current profile within the write transaction, suppresses output and preserves logical cancellation. Scope checks do not renew grants; final physical stop may still settle capacity/budget.

Reviewed skill autoload is checked and inserted explicitly into real-agent ephemeral system context. Native tool construction and dispatch seams are denied; broker refuses tool-bearing requests and tool-shaped responses.

Exactly one durable upstream attempt fence precedes fixed OpenAI HTTPS dispatch; redirects, widened output bounds, multiple completions and stale/deadline authority are refused. Original absolute deadline is retained.
Inspect is read-only, never starts a gateway or replays POST; retained task identity includes input/profile/scope/correlation/deadline, and existing task directories return observations only.

Stop acknowledgment is not final proof: actual child handle, owner-death pipe and zero retained broker inflight govern stopped evidence. Unknown responses preserve identity/admission through Foundation.
Separate sealed execution venv records pinned core/lock provenance and exact tree hashes; upstream HTTP extra is installed without adopting incomplete state or modifying the verified core source.
Direct pinned APIServerAdapter host retains the real durable Runs API while removing generic messaging/session-authority runners. Exact reviewed skill prompt remains injected into real-agent context.
Polling returns only observation fields, preventing stale snapshots from overwriting durable monotone attempt counters or private authentication identities.
Broker close joins retained upstream-handler settlement until its original deadline plus bounded cleanup allowance; stopped proof remains false when inflight cannot be proven zero.
Post-admission helper exceptions preserve the retained providerRunId through final cleanup and emit its bounded observation. Validated replies publish explicit Content-Length and safe phase metadata.
